text: SitRep63 Tableau 6: 722 in isolation at end of day (266 confirmed / 456 suspected) at 85.3% global bed occupancy (722/846 beds); Ituri 78.0% (541/693), Nord-Kivu 126.2% on a carried 141-bed denominator (capacity not reported 16/07), Tshopo 25.0% (3/12). Exits over 24h (120 total): 24 deaths, 62 non-cases, 22 recoveries, 8 escapes, 2 HGR transfers; 106 admissions. J-1 bed count 735. The national bed identity is off by one (735 + 106 - 120 = 721 vs the 722 census), traced to the Nord-Kivu column (182 + 34 - 39 = 177 vs 178 printed); Ituri and Tshopo close exactly. Saturation persists at CT Bambu and CTE CME Rwampara; 51 patients severe or critical and the Nyankunde CTE resumed with a restricted team.

text: 56 new confirmed cases (Ituri 44, Nord-Kivu 8, Haut-Uele 4) and 36 new deaths (Ituri 28, Nord-Kivu 7, Tshopo 1); DRC cumulative 2181 confirmed / 864 deaths (CFR 39.6%). New confirmations rose from 51 to 56 while Ituri's alert-investigation rate recovered to 68.9% from 28.1% and contact follow-up fell to 66.9% from 80.3%: the operational bottleneck moved from alert triage to contact tracing within a single cycle, and the +51->+56 rise is consistent with the prior cycle's dip having been a detection-capacity floor rather than a real decline.

text: Haut-Uele resumed reporting after two silent cycles, transmitting a 9-16 July backfill: +4 confirmed at Wamba take the province to 18/13 across four zones, with Aba and Doruma on alert. No new health zone was affected; the national count holds at 46 touched / 45 with active transmission, and Miti-Murhesa (Sud-Kivu) reached day 51 with no new confirmed case, continuing toward a provincial end-of-outbreak declaration.

text: Contact follow-up collapsed to 66.9% nationally (9079/13571), far below the 95% threshold and down from 80.3%, and INSP names it the cycle's principal operational alert. Ituri's contacts under follow-up fell from 10183 to 7944 with 234 lost to view and 4 turned suspect; the Uganda-border axis stayed active (Ariwara +3, Mahagi holding at 1). Tshopo recorded no new day-case but a retrospective +1 consolidation and a confirmed death.
